description: Create a new Avalanche dapp from a template (minimal, nft-mint, token-gated-app, erc20-token, icm-messenger, eerc-token, l1-launch, token-bridge). Wraps create-avalanche-app. Returns the created files, next steps, and `artifacts`: the paths of the project's compiled contracts, which deploy_contract and write_contract take as artifactPath — nothing has to be read or copied to deploy and call them. Each template supports only the chains list_templates shows for it — most are Fuji-only — and any other chain is refused. The project is created inside the server's working directory (or AVAKIT_MCP_ROOT, when the server was started with it); a directory outside it is refused.

chain.description: Must be one of the template's chains (see list_templates). c-chain is mainnet.

directory.description: Parent directory for the project. Must be inside the server's working directory, which is also the default.

local.description: Only for developing AvaKit itself: links @avakit/* with workspace:*, so the app installs only inside the AvaKit monorepo. Leave unset.

name: scaffold_app
title: Scaffold an Avalanche dapp
